result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear content defect (a duplicated restaurant card) plus a few minor layout/truncation issues typical of horizontally scrolling carousels.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the exact same restaurant card twice ('Green Bowl Poké', 15–25 min, €0.90 delivery) side by side, which looks like a data duplication bug.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the restaurant list in the carousel data source so each venue appears only once.

issues.description: The last category chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge, showing only an empty sliver of a pill with no visible label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so the partially visible chip shows at least part of its label, signaling scrollability without looking broken.

issues.description: The third carousel card's title is truncated ('Smash Bros Bu…') without an ellipsis or clear indication of continuation.
issues.suggestion: Apply text ellipsis truncation to card titles, or ensure the peeking card clearly reads as partially off-screen carousel content.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' item (pizza card with −20% badge) is abruptly clipped by the bottom navigation bar, cutting through the image mid-card.
issues.suggestion: This is expected scroll behavior, but adding bottom padding or a fade/scrim above the nav bar would make the cutoff feel less jarring.
